title: Instruction regarding MODIFICATION IN INSTRUCTION NO.RJ/31/2025, DATED 15.09.2025 AND RJ/33/2025 DATED 25.09.2025
text:
KEY LINES:
15.09.2025
25.09.2025
15.09.2025
dated 25.09.2025,
09.10.2025

FULL TEXT:
MODIFICATION
IN
INSTRUCTION
NO.RJ/31/2025,
DATED
15.09.2025
AND
RJ/33/2025
DATED
25.09.2025
In
partial
modification
of
earlier
Instruction
No.RJ
/31/2025
dated
15.09.2025
and
Instruction
No.RJ/33/2025
dated 25.09.2025,
all
the
Litigants,
Stakeholders
and
Party-in-Person
are
hereby
informed
that the
Honourable
the
Chief
Justice
has been
pleased
to
direct
that
minor
corrections, alterations
or deletions
can
be
done
by
filing
draft
amendments
under
the signature
of
the
Advocate/Party-
in-Person,
as the
case
may
be
and
said
draft
amendment
shall
beplaced
before
the
Hon'ble
Court concerned
for
consideration as
part
of
the
main
matter.
So
far
as
substantial
amendments
are
concerned,
the
usual
practice
of
filing
of
Civil/Criminal Application
has
to
be
followed.
All
the
concerned
are,
therefore,
directed
to
follow
the
above
instructions
scrupulously.
Date:
09.10.2025
By
order
of
the Hon'ble Chief Justice
